residue.item: The bluffed alternative
residue.why: deception about existing value, nothing synthesized

residue.item: Splitting the difference
residue.why: arithmetic on the existing surface, not an invention

residue.item: The recess
residue.why: a tactic of pacing, not a chip that changes the ledger

gaps: Current originals concentrate on timing, symbolic standing, secrecy, contingent prices, and third-party custody; they underdescribe technically usable performance rights.
Simultaneous use partitions, derivative-work entitlements, and continuity or migration deliverables.
Evidence retention, calibration funding, and limited positive information access rather than audit triggers alone.
Complementary capacity, shared connectors, entry liquidity, and critical-mass commitments.
The first enrichment still leaves multilateral settlement, coalition accession and dilution, missing principals, successor obligations, and allocation of residual assets thin.
gate: list-excellences; open conceptual or phenomenological hypotheses

accepted.item: The field-of-use split: concurrent licenses to different applications of the same invention
accepted.why: Creates separately grantable use rights without dividing the physical invention. Unlike the phase claim, the split is simultaneous by application rather than sequential by delivery; it can satisfy incompatible demands for sole control in different markets.

accepted.item: The improvement grant-back: access to each licensee's later refinements bundled with present permission
accepted.why: Creates a reciprocal entitlement to future derivative work, not just an option to buy it. It can compensate a licensor for enabling a capable future competitor; the scope must exclude unrelated work.

accepted.item: The breakdown step-in license: repair authority and operating instructions released on supplier failure
accepted.why: Creates contingent authority to continue service with a substitute operator. Unlike a cooling-off right or damages side-bet, it preserves performance instead of unwinding or paying for loss; lawful access and capability must be deliverable.

accepted.item: The portable exit package: export formats and transition assistance priced into entry
accepted.why: Creates a usable migration deliverable and assistance claim. Unlike permission to cancel, it lowers the practical switching burden that can block assent before any failure occurs; it does not promise to reverse disclosed information.

accepted.item: The counterpeak capacity swap: reserved throughput in each side's otherwise idle hours
accepted.why: Creates reciprocal reservations over complementary load periods, making a quantity or delivery promise possible without new peak plant. This is a concrete scheduling mechanism under the original broad cheap-to-you currency, not another name for favorable cost differences.

accepted.item: The jointly owned adapter: a funded interface joining otherwise incompatible assets
accepted.why: Creates shared connecting infrastructure rather than allocating an existing asset or conceding a position. The new interoperability can make both contributions usable in one bargain; distinguish it from the remediation fund's pooling against a hazard.

accepted.item: The replay entitlement: preserved samples and records available for independent remeasurement
accepted.why: Creates custody, retention, and reuse rights over evidence that might otherwise disappear. Unlike an audit tripwire that substitutes a future test for today's disputed fact, it enables alternative later tests of the same underlying material.

accepted.item: The calibration challenge budget: prepaid independent checks of the instrument that sets payment
accepted.why: Creates a funded right to contest measurement reliability, not just inspect the measured output. It makes a metric-priced deal more acceptable when the original graduated tie otherwise exposes a party to instrument bias; distinguish calibration from the replay entitlement's preserved evidence.

accepted.item: The bounded-query license: agreed computations over private records without raw-record access
accepted.why: Creates a positive, limited analytic service right where full disclosure is unacceptable. Unlike the confidentiality wrapper's prohibition on onward disclosure, it grants useful access without transferring the underlying records; requires a workable disclosure-limiting implementation.

accepted.item: The threshold subscription: binding contributions released only with a viable participating set
accepted.why: Creates conditional collective financing commitments, so no subscriber must buy an unusable fragment alone. Unlike the neutral holder, its distinct mechanism is an explicitly defined participation threshold; custody may implement but does not supply that condition.

accepted.item: The participation advance: entry costs funded against the entrant's later agreed distributions
accepted.why: Creates a financing claim tied to the bargain's own proceeds, making an otherwise cash-constrained contribution feasible. Unlike a sequencing premium, it supplies liquidity before performance rather than merely prices who goes first; losses and repayment limits must be agreed.

accepted.item: The substitute-delivery menu: a paid right to switch among prequalified ways of fulfilling one obligation
accepted.why: Creates a bounded choice among technically acceptable performances, relieving commitment to one fragile means while preserving the promised end. Unlike a generic option on an unknown future, it specifies an operational substitution right; unlike a review clause, exercise does not require renegotiation.

residue.item: The compliance bonus: an extra payment when the agreed target is met
residue.why: Already a contingent clause or graduated tie; attaching a favorable name to conditional price does not add a mechanism.

residue.item: The loss insurance: compensation if the risky concession turns out badly
residue.why: As stated, duplicates the side-bet's contingent compensation. A new insurer or domain label does not establish an additional category.

residue.item: The rotating chair: leadership traded in alternating periods
residue.why: A familiar time-slice of authority within the phase claim and veto allocation; no distinct bargaining good beyond that decomposition is specified.

residue.item: The quiet trial: confidential permission for a small experiment
residue.why: Only a pilot plus the existing confidentiality wrapper; combinatorial phrasing is not sufficient novelty.

residue.item: The second-look option: another chance to reconsider after new evidence
residue.why: Already the review clause or cooling-off right, depending on its effect.

residue.item: The invented regulator: an absent authority invoked to make refusal impersonal
residue.why: Matches the rejected bluffed alternative and the original principal's defect: false constraint, no genuinely constructed entitlement.

residue.item: The pledged embarrassment: secrets held for release if a party defects
residue.why: Coercive disclosure threat, not legitimate performance security; the repaired reciprocal bonds deliberately exclude this mechanism.

residue.item: The goodwill account: a promise that cooperation will be remembered
residue.why: No redeemable entitlement or specified obligation. Merely asserting future relational value does not construct a chip.

limits: Two authored breaths and one independent model gate, not empirical validation or a world novelty search.
Keep rate covers enumerated growth candidates; any extra repair-origin admissions are recorded separately.

gaps: Induced from the 44-item repaired and enriched list: bilateral performance is substantially represented, but claims among several creditors are not.
Critical mass now has a chip; later accession, reimbursement of early contributors, and dilution of membership rights still need distinct treatment.
Shared infrastructure now exists, but common asset remains, successor ownership, and beneficiary rights outside the signatory coalition remain unallocated.
Reservations and bonds now exist, but unused allocations, release of retired exposure, and priority under insufficient assets are not separated.

After this breath, treatment remains thin for jurisdiction-dependent public powers, cross-border insolvency, and rights that cannot legitimately be traded; no generic entries are admitted merely to fill those spaces.
gate: list-excellences; open conceptual or phenomenological hypotheses

accepted.item: The clearing ring: multilateral debt offsets exchanged for a smaller net cash settlement
accepted.why: Creates a consented discharge arrangement across a cycle of obligations, allowing a cash-starved bilateral bargain to close through third-party credits. Unlike the participation advance, it reduces gross funding needed instead of lending that funding; every affected creditor must join.

accepted.item: The accession credit: later entrants' buy-ins returned to the coalition's early infrastructure funders
accepted.why: Creates an explicit future reimbursement claim for early contributors, making initial funding less exposed to free riding. Unlike the threshold subscription, it addresses entrants after viability is reached; unlike the most-favored promise, it compensates prior investment rather than equalizing terms.

accepted.item: The reserved consent seat: a protected approval right over later dilution of a joining member's agreed powers
accepted.why: Creates a non-dilution entitlement governing coalition expansion. Unlike a swap of vetoes across substantive domains, it protects the composition and weight of membership rights themselves; it cannot bind outsiders or remove their independent rights.

accepted.item: The affected-party service claim: a funded remediation entitlement assigned directly to non-signatory beneficiaries
accepted.why: Creates a claim on specified repair services held by those bearing an agreed external burden, rather than leaving all benefits inside the bargaining coalition. Unlike the joint remediation fund, the distinct addition is an identified outside beneficiary's enforceable claim; participation cannot waive unrepresented people's rights or license otherwise impermissible harm.

accepted.item: The successor-assumption condition: a transfer of the pledged asset tied to adoption of its service obligations
accepted.why: Creates a condition on an authorized transfer so the promised service cannot be stripped away merely by changing ownership. Unlike the step-in license, it preserves the obligation through succession rather than granting emergency operating authority; its enforceability depends on the asset and jurisdiction.

accepted.item: The residual-asset partition: predetermined claims on shared equipment and data when the venture dissolves
accepted.why: Creates allocated rights over the collaboration's future remains, removing an otherwise unpriced struggle over what joint investment leaves behind. Unlike sunset, this specifies asset disposition rather than ending duties; unlike portable exit, it divides common property rather than supplying migration help.

accepted.item: The complement license bundle: one authorized package of permissions that are useless separately
accepted.why: Creates jointly deliverable clearance over independently controlled complementary rights. Unlike the field-of-use split, it assembles permissions instead of separating uses; unlike the threshold subscription, its good is consolidated legal permission rather than contingent pooled finance. Every rights holder must actually authorize the package.

accepted.item: The carryover bank: unused allocations converted into bounded claims on later capacity
accepted.why: Creates a redeemable interperiod entitlement where unused allowances would otherwise expire, making uncertain demand compatible with a present quantity commitment. Unlike the counterpeak swap, it carries a balance across periods rather than matching reciprocal idle windows; aggregate redemption needs a real reserve or agreed capacity limit.

accepted.item: The collateral-release ladder: portions of the pledged security freed as exposure is retired
accepted.why: Creates a specified right to recover excess collateral during performance, making a secured bargain less costly to finance. The repaired performance bonds provide security; this addition makes that security divisible by remaining exposure rather than holding the entire pledge until the end. It is not payment of a sequencing premium.

accepted.item: The loss-priority stack: senior recovery claims exchanged for junior participation in the residual surplus
accepted.why: Creates differentiated claims on the same venture's assets and losses, letting parties with different tolerance for downside hold different ranks. Unlike a side-bet, it establishes priority when the pool cannot pay everyone, not merely a transfer triggered by a disputed outcome; it cannot guarantee the senior claim against an empty pool.

residue.item: The universal admission ticket: membership available to every later applicant on identical terms
residue.why: A naked equality promise repeats the most-favored promise and ignores coalition feasibility; no separate membership capacity or obligation is constructed.

residue.item: The procurement club: purchases combined until suppliers offer a lower price
residue.why: As stated, a threshold subscription in another domain. A claimed bulk discount is not itself a constructed entitlement without supplier assent.

residue.item: The emergency supplier swap: a replacement contractor nominated after failure
residue.why: The substitute-delivery menu already grants a prequalified substitution right, and the step-in license covers continuity after failure; renaming the performer does not yet isolate another mechanism.

residue.item: The all-or-nothing option basket: several asset purchases exercised only together
residue.why: A close sibling of the threshold commitment mechanism. Although useful, conditional assembly alone does not earn another item here; complementary legal clearance is retained separately because it creates a unified usable permission.

residue.item: The appeal purse: a prepaid fund for challenging later decisions
residue.why: Too close to the funded calibration challenge when expressed only as another paid challenge venue; authority and remedy remain unspecified.

residue.item: The amendment lockbox: proposed changes held until all affected members consent
residue.why: Duplicates conditional collective release in the threshold subscription, combined with the existing review right; no new tradeable good beyond those entitlements is named.

residue.item: The queue-jump coupon: priority over ordinary delivery for a separate price
residue.why: Already the sequencing premium and right of first refusal's priority mechanism in a different queue; it adds no independent construction.

residue.item: The exit valuation formula: departing members paid according to the agreed metric
residue.why: The graduated tie already makes price a function of a metric, and the new residual-asset partition addresses actual property disposition. Formula wording alone is insufficient differentiation.

residue.item: The outsider silence payment: compensation conditional on affected people abandoning all objections
residue.why: Potential purchase of silence or overbroad waiver, not an adequate account of consent or remedy. Retain the direct service claim instead; compensation cannot establish authority over absent parties' rights.

residue.item: The captive fallback: alternatives disabled so the remaining cooperative package becomes attractive
residue.why: Manufactured dependence, the same boundary failure as the commissioned enemy and pledged embarrassment. Removing alternatives and selling relief is not a legitimate invention of cooperative surplus.

limits: Two authored breaths and one independent model gate, not empirical validation or a world novelty search.
Keep rate covers enumerated growth candidates; any extra repair-origin admissions are recorded separately.

dispositions.before: The invented principal whose ratification buys distance and delay
dispositions.proposed: The jointly chartered ratifier: a real approval mandate exchanged for a bounded decision interval
dispositions.why: In-register 'invented' = actually constituted; the interposed-ratifier mechanism is real and the distance/delay is real either way. Fictitious variants are already policed by the inherited bluff exclusion at the contextual-validity level.

dispositions.before: The invented deadline that converts positional patience into shared urgency
dispositions.proposed: The reserved closing window: a dated commitment of staff and capacity exchanged for timely assent
dispositions.decision: retained as distinct addition, original restored
dispositions.why: A self-imposed deadline is a Schelling commitment device the party makes true; nothing in the string asserts a fabricated external constraint.

dispositions.before: The sunset that makes any deal agreeable because it provably ends
dispositions.proposed: The sunset: a dated release from obligations that makes a limited term negotiable
dispositions.why: Remove the universal claim that expiry makes any agreement acceptable and the unsupported claim of provability; irreversible effects and enforcement failures can survive expiry.

dispositions.before: The review clause that converts a forever-decision into a rental
dispositions.proposed: The review clause: a scheduled right to reopen specified terms without reopening the whole deal
dispositions.why: Review does not make an agreement a rental or guarantee an exit. Define the new procedural entitlement; keep it separate from sunset and cooling-off.

dispositions.before: The exploding intermediate: an offer that decays on schedule
dispositions.proposed: The capacity-release schedule: a reserved offer stepped down as its committed resources return to use
dispositions.why: An offer's decay is credible by construction (the offeror controls it); 'merely theatrical' is the repairer's import, not the string's claim.

dispositions.before: The divisible fiction: an atomic good sliced into tradeable phases
dispositions.proposed: The phase claim: a separately deliverable stage carved from an all-or-nothing package
dispositions.decision: retained as distinct addition, original restored
dispositions.why: Sharpest register loss of the 14. Consensual legal fictions of divisibility (time-sharing use of an indivisible good, condominium arrangements) are a real, load-bearing, jointly authorized mechanism; the string honestly labels the fiction.

dispositions.before: The precedent shield: the concession framed as categorically unrepeatable
dispositions.proposed: The precedent shield: an explicit waiver of reliance on this concession in later claims
dispositions.why: 'Framed as' claims no efficacy — it names the framing move honestly; no overclaim to repair. The waiver is merely the hardened implementation and earns no separate item.

dispositions.before: The confidentiality wrapper that makes a concession invisible and therefore affordable
dispositions.proposed: The confidentiality wrapper: agreed disclosure limits exchanged for a concession
dispositions.why: Secrecy cannot guarantee invisibility or affordability. This is a commitment between authorized parties, not permission to conceal facts from people entitled to them.

dispositions.before: The face-saving fiction both parties agree to treat as fact
dispositions.proposed: The face-saving acknowledgment: a mutually authorized statement of standing without a false factual claim
dispositions.why: The canonical face-saving device, honestly labeled as fiction, consensual between the negotiators; requiring 'no false factual claim' is an ethics gate the category does not carry. Clearest sanitization of the 14.

dispositions.before: The neutral holder invented so neither side must trust the other
dispositions.proposed: The neutral custody mandate: conditional release authority lodged with an agreed holder
dispositions.why: The tail is literally accurate — bilateral trust is removed, relocated to the holder; the repair fixed a claim the original never made.

dispositions.before: The third issue imported solely to be conceded
dispositions.proposed: The added service tranche: a newly promised deliverable exchanged for movement on the blocked issue
dispositions.why: The straw/ritual concession-currency move is a documented mechanism, often transparent to both sides (padded demands enabling visible reciprocity); the replacement is ordinary pie-expansion, not an invention.

dispositions.before: The definitional concession: a word's boundary redrawn until both claims fit inside
dispositions.proposed: The definitional schedule: separately specified entitlements under the disputed word
dispositions.decision: retained as distinct addition, original restored
dispositions.why: Constructive ambiguity — the classic diplomatic device (withdrawal 'from territories'). The replacement is its exact converse (specification), a different mechanism; keep both, not the swap.

dispositions.before: The exchange of equivalent vulnerabilities, mutual exposure held as bond
dispositions.proposed: The reciprocal performance bonds: recoverable deposits pledged against each side's specified default
dispositions.decision: retained as distinct addition, original restored
dispositions.why: Consensual mutual exposure (hostage exchange, cross-shareholding, co-dependence) is a real constructed bond distinct from bounded recoverable deposits; 'may mean hostage-taking' is contextual validity, not category failure.

dispositions.before: The common enemy commissioned to make the table one side
dispositions.proposed: The joint remediation fund: matched contributions pledged to reduce a pre-existing shared hazard
dispositions.decision: retained as distinct addition, original restored
dispositions.why: Alignment-by-adversary, including genuinely commissioned adversaries, is a documented dark mechanism; the repair honestly admits it 'replaces the original mechanism' — which is exactly what a repair may not do to an analytical register.

additional_item_rationales: The reserved closing window: a dated commitment of staff and capacity exchanged for timely assent (real reserved deliverable, distinct from the pure temporal commitment of the restored deadline)
The phase claim: a separately deliverable stage carved from an all-or-nothing package (feasible staging, distinct from consensual fictional division; also distinct from the pilot's stake-shrinking)
The definitional schedule: separately specified entitlements under the disputed word (specification, converse of restored ambiguity; both are real practice)

The reciprocal performance bonds: recoverable deposits pledged against each side's specified default (bounded third-form collateral, distinct from unbounded mutual exposure; the collateral-release ladder correctly attaches to it)
The joint remediation fund: matched contributions pledged to reduce a pre-existing shared hazard (pooled funding against an independent problem, distinct from adversary-alignment)
